findings.finding: R9A0_DATABASE_SLICE_MANIFEST.json was not updated after MIGRATION_LEDGER.json changed in the final commit; the manifest cannot validate the frozen head.
latest_thread_state selects the greatest event_sequence only and ignores explicit supersession and acknowledgement semantics, repeating the prior latest-sequence-only projection defect.
supersedes_event_id and acknowledges_event_id enforce existence only; cross-thread references and multiple successors/forks remain legal.
Privileged RPC and tables remain postgres-owned and RLS is not forced; the dedicated no-login least-privilege owner boundary is not implemented.

The test file runs business calls as postgres and does not exercise actual anon/authenticated/service-role RPC paths, concurrency, cross-thread/fork rejection, projection correctness, payload boundaries, migration-receipt mutation, or search-path shadowing.
The exact applied statement was committed after hosted apply. The deviation is transparently recorded, but exact repository-first application was not achieved and must not recur.
